It started on a rugby field

Our partnership started on a rugby field, where we learned the value of skill, hard work and collaboration. 

When we met, Eric was an engineer in the high tech automation industry and Craig had recently completed a demanding four-year building apprenticeship program in New Zealand, his native country, where construction standards are high and workers are known for their obsessive dedication to excellence.  

We saw an opportunity to use our unique skill sets to form a partnership off the field and create a new type of construction company that makes remodeling less stressful and more transparent. 

For more than two decades, we have provided high-quality kitchen remodels, bath renovations, and additions to Santa Cruz County homeowners.  We’re selective about the projects we take on and we always deliver high-quality work backed by our Elite guarantee.

pages.text:

Transparent project pricing

We believe transparency and trust go hand in hand. We include a complete breakdown of labor, materials and subcontractors costs, so that you have an exact understanding of where your money is being spent. 

We are always happy to provide a free no obligation, preliminary estimate for any project you are considering. 

Estimated kitchen costs
Kitchen

Economy      40k+

Better            55k+

Best               65k+  

Large Kitchen

Economy      45k+

Better             65k+

Best                100k+

Item 1 of 2
Estimated bathroom renovation costs
Medium bathroom

Economy      20k+

Better            25k+

Best              35k+  

Large bathroom

Economy      20k+

Better             35k+

Best                60k+

Item 1 of 2
What does each category mean?

“Economy”

This is what a typical Income/rental property remodel might cost. We don’t work on projects at this level, but if you shop around you can find contractors that do.

“Better”

Includes cabinet upgrades such as soft close drawers and full extension glides and upgraded appliances and fixtures. Counter tops may be quartz or granite with a decorative backsplash. It may also include some minor site modifications.

“Best”

Includes high-end custom cabinetry, designer fixtures and restaurant grade appliances. It may include relocating load bearing walls, appliances and/or plumbing fixtures.

pages.text:
Skip to Content
Contact
About
Blog
Our process is clear

Our goal is provide you with as much information as possible so you can create your ideal space without breaking the bank or losing your mind.

Call or email us with your ideas for your project.  If you want to share photos of your current space and your design ideas, Pinterest boards, or Houzz boards, it helps us give you a ballpark idea of cost.  This will help you determine if we are a good fit for your building project.

1. Initial consultation
Schedule a consultation

Our designer will schedule a visit to your home to discuss your tastes and personal style. We want to get a feel for your desires for your project and your budget requirements so we can provide you with an accurate bid. 

2. Site visit
Schedule a consultation

Let’s review your project estimate.  We’ll go through the bid line by line and answer any questions you might have.  Various design and construction options will be presented so you can adjust your project to fit your budget and the look of the final outcome. 

3. Estimate
Schedule a consultation

You’ve seen the initial plans and have had some time to price out appliances, fixtures and other accessories.  Time to finalize your project layout so we can get started.

4. Finalize your design
Schedule a consultation

Start your project with the assurance that you will be in conversation with us during the whole process.  Our online portal gives you detailed timelines for materials needed (such as tile, fixtures, etc.) and install dates for all phases.  The portal also shows you a running total of expenses so you can keep track of your budget..

5. Build it
Schedule a consultation
6. Relax and enjoy

You did it!  Delight in your completed project.  Rest assured that should any issues arise, we’ve got you covered by the Elite guarantee.  

Schedule a consultation

“From the start of the bid process to the completion of the project, Elite bends over backwards with their exemplary customer service and workmanship. We are beyond thrilled with the results! If you want it done on time, on budget and to exceed your expectations, call Elite. There is no question that we will contract with Elite on our next project!”

-Chris D, Scotts Valley
